en: Takes effect immediately: screens, dialogs and notifications switch together, without restarting the page.
zh: 立即生效：页面、对话框、通知同步切换，不重进页面。

en: Reset icons, wallpaper, colors and spacing
zh: 重置图标、壁纸、颜色与间距

en: No plugin widgets to add. Install a plugin with a PluginPage slot first.
zh: 没有可添加的插件组件：先到插件页装一个带 PluginPage 槽位的插件

en: Always = never ask again; This session = ask once per run; Every time = ask on each call. When the system permission is not granted, the action returns E_PERMISSION_DENIED (with needsPermission) instead of throwing or failing silently.
zh: 常驻允许 = 以后不再问；本会话 = 本次运行内确认一次后不再问；每次询问 = 每次调用都要点允许。系统权限没给时动作返回 E_PERMISSION_DENIED（带 needsPermission），不会抛异常，也不会静默失败。
免 root 操控 · 待授权

en: Search, install, back up and roll back
No open chat, so the plugin action "%1$s" has nowhere to go
zh: 没有打开的会话，插件动作「%1$s」无处发送

en: Persona updated for this chat; it applies from the next message
zh: 本会话人设已更新，下一条消息起生效

zh: 本会话本来就没设人设

zh: HTML 渲染插件没注册，代码块仍是源码视图

en: Diagram rendering ready: mermaid / dot / echarts / svg blocks are drawn
zh: 图形渲染已就绪：mermaid / dot / echarts / svg 等代码块会画成图

en: No diagram renderer registered; code blocks stay as source
zh: 图形渲染插件没注册，代码块仍是源码视图

en: No plugin widgets to add. Install a plugin with a Drawer slot first.
zh: 没有可添加的插件组件：先到插件页装一个带抽屉槽位的插件

en: Try another keyword: chat title or message text
zh: 换个关键词：会话标题或消息正文

zh: 输入会话标题或消息正文里的片段

zh: 稍等片刻，本地会话列表马上就好

en: Tap + to start one, or sync history in Settings
zh: 点右上角 + 新建，或在设置里同步历史会话

en: Add a model on the Agents page first, then tap + to start chatting
zh: 先在 Agent 页添加一个模型，再点右上角 + 开始对话

en: Add a model (with its API key) on the Agents page, then come back and tap +
zh: 先在 Agent 页添加模型（填 API Key），再回到这里点 + 新建对话

en: All groups are collapsed — expand a folder chip above, or sync history in Settings
zh: 分组都收起了：点上方文件夹条展开，或到设置里同步历史会话

en: No plugin widgets to add — install a plugin with a chat-list slot first
zh: 没有可添加的插件组件：先到插件页装一个带会话列表槽位的插件

en: Delete %1$d selected chats? Their messages go with them and cannot be recovered.
zh: 删除已选的 %1$d 项会话？消息记录会一并删除，无法恢复。

en: %1$d chats in this folder and its subfolders move to "%2$s"; the chats themselves are kept.
zh: 文件夹及子文件夹内 %1$d 个会话会移入「%2$s」，会话本身不删除。

en: Delete failed — some chats may already be archived, try again
zh: 删除失败，部分会话可能已归档，请重试

en: Workspace path (blank = default dir; outputs land here)
zh: 工作区路径（留空用默认目录，产物落在这里）

en: Pick agents (the same one may be added twice)
zh: 选择 Agent（可重复拉同一个）

en: No agents connected yet — add an API key on the Agents page
zh: 还没有接入 Agent，先到 Agent 页添加 API Key

en: API keys and the default model
One API key is enough to put an agent to work (DeepSeek / OpenAI-compatible / any relay)
zh: 填一个 API Key 就能让 Agent 干活（DeepSeek / OpenAI 兼容 / 第三方中转都可以）

en: API key / base URL / model name
zh: API Key / Base URL / 模型名

en: Go back to Chats and tap + to create one
zh: 回到会话页点右上角 + 新建一个

en: Delete "%1$s"? Its API key goes too and cannot be recovered.
zh: 删除「%1$s」？API Key 会一起删除，无法恢复。

en: The engine plugin reported no models — check that it is installed and was started on the Plugins page, or type a model name directly
zh: 引擎插件没有上报模型：确认插件已安装并在插件页启动过，或直接手填模型名

en: Top P (0-1, decimals ok, blank = omit)
zh: Top P（0-1，可小数，留空 = 不发送）

en: When off, requests carry no tools
zh: 关闭后请求里不带 tools

en: Picked through the system file picker (image/*) and copied into the app's private directory, so no SAF grant is needed later. Non-square images are scaled uniformly, never cropped.
zh: 图片从系统文件选择器取（image/*），会复制一份到应用私有目录（不再依赖 SAF 授权），非正方形图按等比缩放不裁切。

en: Without a background image the theme's flat colors are used.
zh: 未设置背景图时按主题走纯色。

en: The image fills the screen (centerCrop); dimming keeps text readable over bright wallpapers. With material set to None the wallpaper is not drawn.
zh: 背景图铺满全屏（centerCrop），压暗用来救亮色壁纸上的正文可读性；材质选「无」时壁纸不绘制。

en: Off by default. Spec syntax: builtin:fade / builtin:draw-h / builtin:bounce / image:<uri> / plugin:<id>. A plugin that registers a style of the same name shows up here; an unknown style is skipped. Tap the screen to skip.
zh: 默认关闭。spec 写法：builtin:fade / builtin:draw-h / builtin:bounce / image:<uri> / plugin:<id>；插件注册同名样式即可出现在这里，宿主认不出就退回不播。点屏幕可跳过。

en: Blur (RenderEffect) needs Android 12+. Liquid and Acrylic already blur by default, so the slider can only add on top.
zh: 雾化（RenderEffect）只在 Android 12+ 生效；液态 / 亚克力自带模糊下限，滑块只能往上加。

en: This system is below Android 12: no blur, translucency only.
zh: 当前系统低于 Android 12：不做雾化，只保留半透明降级。

en: Corner radius, font size, density and compact bubbles share the same keys as Restore default appearance.
zh: 圆角 / 字号 / 密度 / 紧凑气泡与「恢复默认外观」共用同一组键。

en: Fully opaque pages; the wallpaper is not drawn.
zh: 页面完全实底，壁纸不参与绘制。

en: Translucent panels with background blur; strength adjusts panel opacity.
zh: 半透明面板 + 背景雾化；强度调面板不透明度。

en: More transparent panels with top highlights and edge refraction; the wallpaper gets a light blur.
zh: 更透的面板 + 顶部高光与边缘折射，壁纸带一层轻微模糊。

en: High opacity with fine noise, heavy frost; strength is fixed, the blur slider still applies.
zh: 高不透明度 + 细噪点，重磨砂；强度固定，雾化滑块仍可用。

en: This deletes the current Linux runtime and downloads it again. Installed plugins and skills are unaffected.
zh: 会删除当前 Linux 运行时并重新下载覆盖，已安装的插件与技能不受影响

en: Queue = send after the current turn; Insert = don't interrupt, attach to the next request; Interrupt = stop the current reply now.
zh: 排队＝等这轮跑完再发；插入＝不打断，下一轮请求带上；打断＝立刻中止当前回复。

en: Collapse the chat list by project
Stick to the bottom when new content arrives
zh: 新内容到达时贴着底部

en: Show turn duration at the bubble's bottom right
zh: 气泡右下角显示本轮用时

en: Distinct colors per agent in group chats
zh: 群聊里不同 Agent 用不同颜色

en: New chats open with thinking expanded
zh: 新会话默认展开思考过程

en: HTML / LaTeX / Markdown / code blocks; new chats start with this

en: Usage capsule in the title bar
Skip the confirmation dialog before running
zh: 跳过执行前的确认弹窗

en: 0 = unlimited. Reasoning models without a cap can write tens of thousands of characters of thinking; a group turn can take over ten minutes.
zh: 0 = 不限制。推理模型不设上限会写出几万字思维链，群组一轮能跑十几分钟。
并行度 / 分工 / 上下文预算

en: The same agent can join a group several times; each instance gets its own context and runs independently.
zh: 同一 Agent 可以被拉进群多次，每个实例独立上下文、独立执行。

en: Auto = pick by member count; Parallel = all at once; Chain = one after another; Review = executor and reviewer alternate.
zh: 自动＝按成员数挑；并行＝同时开工；串行＝依次接力；验收＝执行者与验收者交替。

en: Round robin = everyone speaks once, then turn-taking by priority; Moderated = a moderator model picks the next speaker step by step (one extra lightweight request per step).
zh: 轮转＝首轮全员发言后按优先序接力；主持＝由主持人模型逐步决定下一个发言者（每步多一次轻量请求）。

en: A subagent spawned by the main agent counts as level 1. Deeper levels multiply calls; the default is two.
zh: 主代理派子代理算第 1 层。开太深会成倍放大调用量，默认两层。

en: Let agents claim tasks and hand off to each other in group chats
zh: 群聊时让 Agent 自己认领任务、互相交接

en: When off, group members only reply with text and never run shell
zh: 关闭后群成员只回文字，不跑 shell
同人多次拉入各自独立

en: When the same agent joins a group more than once, each instance tracks its own context (turn off to share it)
zh: 同一个 Agent 进群多次时，每个实例各记各的上下文（关掉会退化成共享）
监督 / 规划 / 检测 / 执行 + 自定义

en: Role cards only tell the model who it is; scheduling is decided by the group orchestration above.
zh: 角色卡只决定「告诉模型它是谁」；怎么排队开工由上面的群组编排决定。
